author: New China TV
description:
Arseniy Kretov, 27, who goes by the Chinese name Yu Hao, hails from Tashkent, Uzbekistan. He is the regional representative of O'ZTEMIRYO'LKONTEYNER (UTK) in China and mainly works in cross-border logistics.
Interested in China, Kretov went to Nanjing in east China's Jiangsu Province to study. During his three years there, he was deeply impressed by China's transportation, medical services and food. After starting his career, Kretov was dispatched by UTK to northwest China's Xinjiang because he was fluent in Chinese.
Kretov currently works with a Chinese team in Urumqi, Xinjiang. His company transports consumer goods, electronic products, fabrics and other products made in China to countries in Central Asia and elsewhere.
Although Kretov only worked in Xinjiang for less than a year, he has already found many market opportunities. His team's business volume has increased every month, which has given him more confidence. Kretov said logistics between China and Central Asia is more than
title: "Laowai" in China | Young Uzbek finds opportunities in cross-border logistics in China's Xinjiang

title: Autumn harvest draws visitors to Guizhou's scenic terraces

description:

title: Malaysian diplomat at CIFIT: China's scale and connectivity are hard to match
